# Task Launch Policy

An abstract connected policy marker for clauses that invoke the package-owned Work request function. It identifies a policy role; it does not itself declare a task-launch action or establish that work has started.

`parameters.workClause` defaults to `"work"` and identifies the intended Work clause. The supplied definition does not show how a request uses this parameter. `bindingTypes` is empty, so this marker declares no property bindings.

It inherits Connected Clause planning: named connections connect actions declared by the exact clause type to native channels and workflows. Executable hooks and templates come from the admitted exact type. The inherited transition check requires an unchanged clause configuration under an existing clause key; changing it requires a new key.

This marker supplies no concrete launch trigger, actor, task state or request body. The Work request function's validation and outcome handling are not specified here; requesting work does not confirm that a task started or completed.
